newsitem.title: ITALY: Rinascente shares slide at Milan start.
newsitem.headline: Rinascente shares slide at Milan start.

text.p: Italy's largest quoted retailer Rinascente opened down 6.92 percent at 8,710 lire per share on the Milan stock market after reaching an accord with France's Auchan on Tuesday.

Dealers noted while the accord had been well received by the market, the stock had been suspended ahead of the announcement yesterday. Traders were now getting their first bite at reaction and taking on board the fact the deal would require a capital increase by Rinascente.
The Rinascente deal with privately-owned French retail group Auchan is to pool their Italian operations to form a new powerful force in Italian retailing.
Agnelli family holding IFIL currently controls Rinascente and IFIL shares were 1.68 percent up at 5290.
